title: Visual Anything scenario file
description: The contents of a `.vascenario` file: a concrete example played step by step over one view.

view.description: The view the scenario plays over.

steps.description: The steps in reading order: every step of every alternative of its decisions (ADR 0078). A scenario without decisions plays them all, in order.

blocks.description: Its decisions, each over a stretch of its steps (ADR 0078); left out when it has none.

Id.description: An identifier, generated once and never reused. Files refer to each other only by id. Element and relation ids share one namespace, because a relation can end on either. Component and relation type ids start with their package's id, as in `systems.service`.

relations.description: The relations the step activates, all at once. A step that uses a relation that no longer exists is a broken step; it is kept so it can be fixed.

ScenarioBlock.description: A structure over a stretch of a scenario's steps. Decisions only, for now (ADR 0078).

question.description: What it decides, as a question: "Are there free slots?".

default.description: The alternative that plays when nothing chooses; the first when left out.

DecisionBlock.description: A point where a scenario goes one of several labelled ways (ADR 0078). Its alternatives' steps are stretches of the scenario's steps that follow one another; a decision may sit inside an alternative of another, at most three deep.

steps.description: Its steps by id, a stretch of the scenario's steps in their order; none for the way where nothing happens.

ends.description: The scenario ends after this alternative, as an error path does.

Alternative.description: One of the ways a decision can go: the steps that play when it is chosen.
